name: dbpedia
weighting: One representative row per distinct FP32 query content, equal weight; not the original duplicate request frequencies.
evidence_scope: Frozen 2026-09-12 campaign query roles, already evaluated. Reusing these rows is reproduction, not a new independent holdout.
conversion: Preserve source base row IDs and values; float16 is expanded to float32. Stored train/test are not normalized.
truth: Exhaustive FP64 cosine over the actual FP32 inputs; depth 100, equal scores ordered by base row ID. Source JSONL ground truth is not used.
